Honua Server is stateless and runs no backup automation of its own; base backups/WAL archiving are owned by the deployment's infrastructure layer. honua-terraform parameterizes managed-database backups (for example RDS automated backups/snapshots and multi-AZ) and documents the backup/restore drill procedure. A bring-your-own-database deployment delegates backup automation entirely to the customer's managed database. No server-side background job or HTTP route performs backups; see docs/guides/deploy/backup-and-restore.md in this repo for the server-side operator guidance that exists today.

There is no cache-state backup/restore feature in this server today (verified: no producer ever records a Redis-snapshot backup; the legacy BackupKind.RedisSnapshot enum value was removed as dead code in #2946). Redis persistence (RDB/AOF) and any cache backup/restore is an infrastructure-layer concern the deployment owns, not a server capability.

Honua Server does not evaluate or trigger failover; promoting a standby and cutting over connections is owned by the deployment's infrastructure/managed-database layer (for example RDS Multi-AZ automated failover), with the drill procedure documented in honua-terraform. A bring-your-own-database deployment delegates failover entirely to the customer's managed database. The Honua.Core FailoverDecisionEvaluator was a pure, unit-tested but uncalled evaluator with no consumer anywhere in the codebase; it was removed as dead code in #2946 rather than being (falsely) counted as the surface behind this key.

Honua Server computes no RTO/RPO posture; recovery-point/recovery-time evidence comes from the infrastructure layer's backup/restore and failover drills, captured against honua-terraform's dr-evidence-template.json schema. A bring-your-own-database deployment's RTO/RPO is defined by the customer's managed database, not by this server. The Honua.Core RecoveryReadinessEvaluator was a pure, unit-tested but uncalled evaluator with no consumer anywhere in the codebase; it was removed as dead code in #2946 rather than being (falsely) counted as the surface behind this key.

Cloud storage provider selection (AWS S3 / Azure Blob) is process-startup dependency-injection wiring driven by configuration/environment variables (for example HONUA_STORAGE_PROVIDER; see FileStorageServiceCollectionExtensions.AddCloudFileStorage), not a request-time HTTP route.
